title: Ranked hiring decision analysis
scope_note: This ranking covers licensed contractors that could lawfully perform a concealed bathtub waste-and-overflow trip-lever repair in a tenant-occupied San Francisco unit, with the plumbing and the ceiling-restoration trades named under one contract. It is an inquiry priority order, not a competence guarantee, not a booking and not a price comparison. No provider was contacted for this analysis.
method: Step 1 - Licence screen. Each candidate was checked against its own CSLB licence-detail page, retrieved directly on 2026-11-08. The licence number, legal entity, classifications, expiry, status and any additional status were transcribed; a provider whose licence is suspended, or whose licence could not be found, is excluded from the ranking instead of being ranked low (see excluded_rows).

Step 2 - Scope screen. A combined plumbing-plus-restoration job needs both trades lawfully covered. Under Business and Professions Code s.7057(b) a B licensee may take a prime contract for other trades only when the contract requires two unrelated trades, or the licensee holds the classification, or it subcontracts an appropriately licensed contractor. So a B + C-36 licence supports a combined prime contract, but it does not by itself prove who performs the drywall; the named restoration party must still be confirmed in writing.

Step 3 - Evidence screen. Providers were ordered by the strength of published, checkable evidence directly about this kind of work, not by marketing claims: a company-published case of the same assembly replaced through ceiling access outranks a general statement that all work is handled.

Step 4 - Estimates are not ranked as prices. The three owner-supplied amounts describe different scopes (replacement; lever/plug/spout with diverter; adjustment only). They are shown as owner-reported context, never as verified prices, and they were not used to reorder the ranking.
Step 5 - Unknowns stay blank. Availability, exact-job acceptance, ceiling-restoration scope, review ratings and verified prices are unconfirmed for every row and are left blank rather than estimated.

criteria.name: Both trades lawfully covered, or a named licensed partner
criteria.why: The job needs waste-piping work plus a ceiling opening and finish. A single licence that covers both, or a prime contract that names a C-9 partner, removes the two-contractor handoff that this unit cannot easily absorb.

criteria.name: Published evidence of this exact assembly or this access route
criteria.why: The lever is stuck inside concealed piping and five or more licensed plumbers have declined to force it. Prior documented experience with a tub waste-and-overflow assembly reached through a ceiling is the closest verifiable proxy for that judgement.

criteria.name: Occupied-tenant and property-manager experience
criteria.why: The unit is occupied, so scheduling, notice, protection of contents and clean-up are part of the deliverable, not extras.

criteria.name: Licence and insurance condition on the day of hiring
criteria.why: Classifications and insurance change. A current status, a recorded workers-compensation position and any CSLB additional status are re-checkable facts a ranking should respect.

criteria.name: Responsiveness to a small, precise scope
criteria.why: A published minimum project size or a commercial-project focus makes a small repair less likely to be accepted, even when the licence is correct.

tiers.name: Tier A - combined-scope prime leads
tiers.definition: Licence covers plumbing and building work, and the company publishes scope evidence consistent with a small repair through to finish work. Ask these first.

tiers.name: Tier B - plumbing or building prime leads
tiers.definition: Lawfully able to be the plumbing prime, but the ceiling restoration must be expressly named or subcontracted. Includes the three providers who supplied the owner estimates.

tiers.name: Tier C - restoration partner and conditional leads
tiers.definition: A specialist restoration partner to be named by the prime, or a building licence with a published limit that needs checking before use.

tiers.name: Excluded
tiers.definition: Suspended licence, or identity not verifiable against an official record. Not ranked.

cost_model.component: Plumbing labour and parts (tub waste-and-overflow assembly, trip lever, P-trap and trap adapter)
cost_model.what_it_is: The trade portion of the work. Scope and parts vary by assembly, so no single verified price exists.
cost_model.evidence: Two owner-supplied amounts describe replacement-type scopes: $614 replacement of waste and overflow, and $550 lever/plug/spout with diverter including labour and materials. A third owner-supplied amount of $135 describes adjustment only. None is a verified price.

cost_model.component: Opening and restoring the storage-unit ceiling (cut, patch, tape, texture, paint)
cost_model.what_it_is: A separate trade from plumbing. No supplied estimate names it, so it is unpriced in every document on file.
cost_model.evidence: None of the three owner-supplied scopes mentions opening or restoring a ceiling. Silence is not an exclusion, and it is not a price.

cost_model.component: SF DBI permit fee, if the work requires a permit
cost_model.what_it_is: A municipal fee paid for the permit, separate from any contractor price.
cost_model.evidence: Official DBI Table 1A-C lists Category 1P at $290 for a single residential unit fixture/shower pan/kitchen-bath remodel with up to two inspections. The applicable category for this job is unconfirmed, so this is a reference fee and not a quote.

cost_model.what_it_is: Hourly or per-half-hour municipal charges that apply if extra visits are needed.
cost_model.evidence: Official DBI Table 1A-C lists regular inspection at $519 per hour, off-hour inspection at $555 per hour and reinspection at $259 per half hour. Applicability to this job is unconfirmed.

cost_model.what_it_is: A legal constraint on how a deposit may be taken, not a price.
cost_model.evidence: CSLB guidance states a written contract is required over $500 and a down payment may be no more than the lesser of 10 percent or $1,000, with a narrow blanket-bond exception.

cost_model.component: Total all-in cost for this unit
cost_model.what_it_is: The figure the owner actually needs before authorising work.
cost_model.evidence: Not established. No provider has supplied a combined quote covering plumbing, ceiling opening, restoration, permit and clean-up. Publishing a total would require inventing at least two of the components.

rows.name: Rapid Flow Plumbing & Rooter
rows.why: Best first call. CSLB shows one licence carrying both B General Building and C-36 Plumbing, so a single prime contract can lawfully span the plumbing repair and the ceiling restoration. The company's own site is explicit about that span - it states it can take a project from a simple repair to a complete renovation, and markets one call, one crew - which is the closest published match to a small repair that also needs a finish repair. It also publishes 24/7 availability and states it is bonded.
rows.cost_basis: No quote on file from this provider. Owner-reported anchors for comparable replacement-type scopes are $614 and $550; official DBI Category 1P reference fee is $290. All three are context, not this provider's price.
rows.limits: CSLB records this licence as exempt from workers' compensation because it certified it has no employees, so confirm who is actually on site and whether any subcontractor is insured. The company's own site advertises 844-BAY-FLOW while CSLB publishes (415) 866-8401; call the CSLB number. No review rating was verified. Ask for the named drywall party in writing.

rows.name: Ace Plumbing & Rooter
rows.why: Strongest tenant-occupied and property-manager evidence. The licence carries B and C-36 plus A, C-4, C-16 and C-10, and CSLB records an actual workers' compensation policy, which matters in an occupied building. The company publishes a dedicated HOAs and property-managers page describing insurance requirements, purchase orders and not-to-exceed limits - the working language of managed buildings. Ranked just below Rapid Flow only because its published service menu is weighted toward plumbing, sewer, water heaters and fire protection rather than repair-plus-finish-work, and it publishes no drywall or restoration evidence.
rows.cost_basis: No quote on file from this provider. Owner-reported anchors for comparable replacement-type scopes are $614 and $550; official DBI Category 1P reference fee is $290. Context only, not this provider's price.
rows.limits: Six classifications do not prove drywall self-performance; name the restoration party under the contract. Workers' compensation policy expires 2027-07-13 and must be current for the work dates. No review rating was verified.

rows.name: Heise's Plumbing
rows.legal_name: TARO GROUP INC dba HEISES PLUMBING
rows.why: Best technical evidence for this exact problem. The company publishes a San Francisco project page describing a tub waste-and-overflow assembly replacement in Ingleside in which the old overflow was removed by accessing the exterior ceiling and a new brass P-trap and trap adapter were installed. That is the same failure mode and the same access-route decision this unit faces. It also links its own CSLB licence from its home page and advertises plumbing plus property repairs under one team. Held at third because the licence has no B or C-9 classification, so ceiling restoration must be subcontracted and named, and because the case page is self-published rather than independently reviewed.
rows.cost_basis: No quote on file from this provider. Owner-reported anchors for comparable replacement-type scopes are $614 and $550; official DBI Category 1P reference fee is $290. Context only, not this provider's price.
rows.limits: Self-reported case content is not an independent review and does not confirm acceptance of this job. The same project page also renders a 'Page Not Found (404)' block under the case text, so treat it as marketing content and confirm the approach by phone. The home page displays a Google 4.9-star / 1,838-review badge that is self-published and was not independently verified.

rows.name: We Do Construction
rows.why: The cleanest combined-contract paper trail of the registry leads. B plus C-36, and its own site maps who does what - plumbing self-performed, electrical and HVAC as licensed subcontractors - which is exactly the structure a combined plumbing-and-drywall contract needs. It also works permit-first as a matter of published practice. Placed in Tier B rather than A only because of scale: its published project bands start at $55K to $120K for a bathroom remodel, which signals that a small trip-lever repair may fall outside the work it prices.
rows.cost_basis: No quote on file. Its published ranges are for whole bathroom and whole-home projects and cannot be read as a price for this repair. Owner-reported anchors for comparable replacement-type scopes are $614 and $550; official DBI Category 1P reference fee is $290.
rows.limits: A published minimum project scale suggests a small job may be declined; that is an inference from their published ranges, not a stated policy. Ask directly whether they will take a repair of this size.

rows.name: Expert Plumbing Solutions
rows.why: Ranked first among the three providers who supplied estimates because its owner-supplied scope is the only one worded as a replacement of the waste and overflow, which matches the failure described. Its own site publishes the matching licence number and street address and lists weekday business hours, which suits Civil Code s.1954 entry during normal business hours. Licence is C-36 only, so the ceiling restoration is outside this provider's classification and must be named separately.
rows.cost_basis: Owner-reported $614 dated 2026-08-30 for 'replace waste and overflow'. Not a verified price: no quote document, no access route, no drywall restoration, no permit, no clean-up and no warranty line was supplied. Verified amount is blank.
rows.limits: Plumbing-only classification. The supplied amount does not reveal whether cutting the ceiling is included. Business hours are published as Monday to Friday 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, so an occupied-unit schedule needs agreeing in advance.

rows.name: Bay Area Plumbing
rows.why: Its owner-supplied scope names the lever, plug and spout with a diverter including labour and materials, and its own site advertises kitchen and bathroom plumbing including bathtub work. Placed below Expert because the supplied wording may describe a spout/diverter assembly rather than the waste-and-overflow assembly that is actually stuck, so the scope needs restating before the price means anything. Licence is C-36 only.
rows.cost_basis: Owner-reported $550 dated 2026-08-30 for 'lever, plug and spout with diverter; labor and materials'. Not a verified price: the assembly description may not match this job, and no access or restoration line is included. Verified amount is blank.
rows.limits: CSLB shows the same street address and phone number as Save-On-Interior #749536; common ownership or control is not confirmed by CSLB and should not be assumed. Workers' compensation is exempt on a certified no-employees basis. Confirm which legal entity would contract.

rows.name: Fast Response Plumbing & Rooter
rows.legal_name: JOSEPH TINSLEY dba FAST RESPONSE PLUMBING AND ROOTER
rows.why: Lowest-supplied amount, and a real service proposition: the site advertises free in-person estimates and per-job quotes with no hourly surprises, seven-day availability, and residential work for houses, apartments and HOAs. Ranked last of the three estimate providers because the supplied scope is adjustment of the plunger handle only. On the facts given - a lever stuck inside concealed piping that several licensed plumbers would not force - an adjustment-only scope is the least likely of the three to resolve it, and it prices no access or restoration.
rows.cost_basis: Owner-reported $135 dated 2026-08-30 for 'repair or adjust bath tub wastewater plunger handle'. Not a verified price, and not a replacement-plus-access price. The site's own free-estimate offer is the cheapest way to test whether $135 is a real quote or a diagnostic. Verified amount is blank.
rows.limits: Its CSLB workers' compensation policy expires 2026-12-18, so confirm cover for any later work date. The site displays a self-published 4.9-star / 1,500-review figure which was not independently verified.

rows.name: Ayoob & Peery Plumbing
rows.why: B plus C-36 with four decades on the licence and full workers' compensation cover, so it can lawfully hold a combined prime contract. Ranked in Tier B because its own site positions it as a mechanical contractor for wet-side building systems and commercial design-build work, which makes acceptance of a single-fixture residential repair uncertain.
rows.cost_basis: No quote on file. Owner-reported anchors for comparable replacement-type scopes are $614 and $550; official DBI Category 1P reference fee is $290. Context only.
rows.limits: Commercial/mechanical focus per its own site. Ask directly whether a single residential fixture repair is work they take.

rows.name: Save-On-Interior
rows.why: B plus C-36 on one licence, which is the structural fit this job needs. Ranked below the other combined leads because no company website or service statement could be verified for it, so there is no evidence of what work it actually offers or at what scale. It shares its CSLB address and phone number with Bay Area Plumbing #757796.
rows.cost_basis: No quote on file. Owner-reported anchors for comparable replacement-type scopes are $614 and $550; official DBI Category 1P reference fee is $290. Context only.
rows.limits: No verified website or service scope. CSLB records two miscellaneous cash-deposit letters dated 2015 and 2016 for this licence; these are board records of correspondence and are carried here for completeness without interpretation. Workers' compensation is exempt on a certified no-employees basis. Confirm the operating entity before contracting.

rows.name: D G Construction
rows.why: B plus C-36 on a long-held licence, so the classification fit is real. Ranked last among the combined leads because CSLB publishes complaint disclosure information for this licence, which a hiring decision should read before any contact is made. No company website or service scope could be verified.
rows.cost_basis: No quote on file. Owner-reported anchors for comparable replacement-type scopes are $614 and $550; official DBI Category 1P reference fee is $290. Context only.
rows.limits: CSLB states there is complaint disclosure information for this licence. Read the disclosure before hiring; this analysis does not characterise it. Workers' compensation is exempt on a certified no-employees basis.

rows.name: Bernal Hill Drywall
rows.why: The only C-9 Drywall licensee found, holding B as well, and its own site specialises in exactly the finish side of this job - patching, matching existing texture, level 5 smooth finishes and complete build-backs after water damage. It is not a plumbing prime because there is no C-36 on the licence, but it is the strongest named restoration partner to pair with any Tier B plumbing lead.
rows.cost_basis: No quote on file and no owner-supplied amount. The restoration component is unpriced in every document on file. Its published pricing is not available, so the cell stays blank.
rows.limits: Restoration only - no plumbing classification. Under BPC s.7057(b) the plumbing must be performed by a C-36 licensee or an appropriately licensed subcontractor named in the contract.

rows.name: SF Building Group
rows.why: Would need to subcontract all of the plumbing. Its own site advertises occupied-space work and trade coordination across San Francisco, which is directly relevant to a tenant-occupied unit, but it also states a focus on larger planned projects. That combination makes it a fallback for coordinating trades, not a first call for a single fixture repair.
rows.cost_basis: No quote on file. Owner-reported anchors for comparable replacement-type scopes are $614 and $550; official DBI Category 1P reference fee is $290. Context only.
rows.limits: B only - plumbing must be licensed and named as a subcontractor. Workers' compensation is exempt on a certified no-employees basis, so confirm who is on site.

rows.name: 24/7 SF Handyman & Remodeling Service
rows.legal_name: HARP SERVICES dba 24/7 SF HANDYMAN & REMODELING SERVICE
rows.why: A B-2 Residential Remodeling licence, not a B. Business and Professions Code s.7057.5 restricts B-2 licence holders on plumbing-system installation, replacement and substantial alteration, and requires at least three unrelated trades on existing residential work. That makes it a poor fit to lead a concealed drainage repair, whatever its remodeling range.
rows.cost_basis: No quote on file. Owner-reported anchors for comparable replacement-type scopes are $614 and $550; official DBI Category 1P reference fee is $290. Context only.
rows.limits: B-2 limits under BPC s.7057.5. No verified website or service statement. Not recommended as the plumbing prime.

rows.name: Advanced Plumbing and Drain
rows.why: Correct plumbing classification and a current status, but CSLB carries an additional status saying the licence may be suspended at a future date for an unresolved final liability. That does not disqualify it today, and it is ranked here rather than excluded, but the status must be re-checked on the day of hiring.
rows.cost_basis: No quote on file. Owner-reported anchors for comparable replacement-type scopes are $614 and $550; official DBI Category 1P reference fee is $290. Context only.
rows.limits: CSLB additional status: may be suspended for failure to resolve an outstanding final liability. Re-verify status immediately before contracting. No verified website or service statement.

rows.name: Caccia Home Services
rows.legal_name: JAMES CACCIA PLUMBING INC dba CACCIA HOME SERVICES
rows.why: Liquid plumbing licence on file since 1979 with full workers' compensation cover. Listed in the registry pool rather than near the top because nothing verified ties it to this kind of concealed-access repair, and its registered address is in Burlingame.
rows.cost_basis: No quote on file. Owner-reported anchors for comparable replacement-type scopes are $614 and $550; official DBI Category 1P reference fee is $290. Context only.
rows.limits: No verified website, service statement or San Francisco base. Registry lead only.

rows.name: Flow Masters Plumbing
rows.why: Valid C-36 with two extra mechanical classifications and current workers' compensation. Registry pool: no verified evidence of this specific work, and its registered address is in Daly City.
rows.cost_basis: No quote on file. Owner-reported anchors for comparable replacement-type scopes are $614 and $550; official DBI Category 1P reference fee is $290. Context only.
rows.limits: No verified website or service statement. Registry lead only.

rows.name: Discount Plumbing Rooter Services
rows.why: The only entry in this register whose CSLB record also shows general liability insurance - $2,000,000 with a $100,000 LLC employee/worker bond - which is a real signal in an occupied building. Held in the registry pool because the licence was issued in 2025, nothing verified ties it to concealed-access work, and its registered address is in Burlingame.
rows.cost_basis: No quote on file. Owner-reported anchors for comparable replacement-type scopes are $614 and $550; official DBI Category 1P reference fee is $290. Context only.
rows.limits: Recently issued licence; no verified service evidence. Registry lead only.

rows.why: Valid C-36 with current cover. Registry pool: no verified evidence of concealed-access work and a Daly City registered address.
rows.cost_basis: No quote on file. Owner-reported anchors for comparable replacement-type scopes are $614 and $550; official DBI Category 1P reference fee is $290. Context only.

rows.why: San Francisco based C-36 with a current status. Registry pool: drain-clearing and rooter focus implied by the business name is not a verified scope, and no evidence ties it to overflow-assembly work.
rows.cost_basis: No quote on file. Owner-reported anchors for comparable replacement-type scopes are $614 and $550; official DBI Category 1P reference fee is $290. Context only.
rows.limits: No verified website or service statement. Workers' compensation is exempt on a certified no-employees basis.

rows.why: Valid C-36. Registry pool: CSLB records that the licence was reissued to another entity on 2026-07-06, so confirm the current operating entity before treating prior work history as relevant.

rows.name: Cahill Contractors
rows.why: A and B with no plumbing classification, and a large commercial general contractor profile. Listed only so the register is complete and so the record can be used to correct a third-party directory that maps this licence number to a different company.

rows.why: Valid C-36 but issued on 2026-09-04, so there is no long operating record to check. Registry pool only.

excluded_rows.name: Kenneth Asire Plumbing
excluded_rows.reason: Excluded, not ranked. CSLB states the licence is under suspension for a contractors-bond suspension, with the bond cancellation recorded on 2026-08-16. CSLB notes that a received replacement bond may not yet be processed, which is why the status must be rechecked rather than assumed either way.

excluded_rows.name: Portola Plumbing Services
excluded_rows.reason: Excluded, not ranked. No CSLB licence record was located for this business name in this session, so its identity, licence number and phone number are blank. Name appears only in a review-platform search excerpt. Do not hire until a licence number is verified on CSLB.

irregularities.title: Public phone number differs between the company site and the CSLB record
irregularities.detail: Rapid Flow's own site advertises 844-BAY-FLOW, while the CSLB licence record publishes (415) 866-8401. This analysis lists the CSLB number so the number traces to a government record, but the two were not reconciled by contacting the company.
irregularities.action: Call the CSLB-listed number, or confirm the 844 number is the same business before relying on it.

irregularities.title: The strongest technical case page also renders a 404 block
irregularities.detail: The Heise's Ingleside project page returns case content and an embedded 'Page Not Found (404)' section in the same response. The case wording is usable as a company-published claim, but the page is unstable and cannot be relied on as a stable public citation without monitoring.
irregularities.action: Treat it as marketing content; confirm the ceiling-access approach by phone and re-check the URL before publishing it anywhere formal.

irregularities.title: Two licences share one address and phone number
irregularities.detail: Bay Area Plumbing #757796 and Save-On-Interior #749536 both record 335 14th Avenue, San Francisco and (415) 668-8000 on CSLB. Common ownership or control is not stated by CSLB and was not established. Which entity would hold a contract for this work is therefore unclear.
irregularities.action: Ask which legal entity issues the contract and confirm the licence number on the written agreement.

irregularities.title: Review evidence could not be verified for any provider
irregularities.detail: Yelp returned HTTP 403 to automated retrieval in this session, and the review figures visible on company sites are self-published badges. No star rating or review count was independently verified for any candidate, so review evidence contributes nothing to this ranking.
irregularities.action: Read the review platforms manually before contacting, and treat the ranking as licence-and-evidence based only.

irregularities.title: No provider was contacted, so acceptance and availability are unknown
irregularities.detail: This ranking is built from official records and published company material only. Whether any provider will take this job, when, at what price, and with which restoration party is unconfirmed for every row. The order is an inquiry sequence, not a shortlist of confirmed suppliers.
irregularities.action: Send one identical written scope to ranks 1 to 3 and record the answers before ranking them again on price and availability.

irregularities.title: Four rows were reported as lacking a source link; the report used an incomplete host list
irregularities.detail: An earlier independent audit reported four table rows without a recognised source link. All four do carry links; three point to codelibrary.amlegal.com, which is the City and County of San Francisco's published code host, and two to company sites that were missing from that audit's host list. The rows were re-checked and are correctly sourced; the audit's host list is incomplete, not the data.
irregularities.action: Extend that audit's official-host list to include the code publisher and the company sites, or note the limitation in its output.

recheck_2026_11_08.method: Each CSLB licence-detail page was retrieved directly on 2026-11-08 and compared field by field with the stored provider register: licence number, phone, expiry, classifications, registered city and legal name. All 23 matched. Five legal names differ only by the separator used before 'dba'.
